description.zh:
返回信息的语言类型：

- zh：中文
- en：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English
The node specifications of the gateway.

descriptions.zh: 更新云原生网关集群节点数或规格，支持按量付费和包年包月，增加节点或升级规格会产生相应资费。具体详情，请参见[价格说明](~~250950~~)。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation to update the number of nodes or the specifications of nodes in a pay-as-you-go or subscription cloud-native gateway. If you add nodes or increase the specifications, you will incur fees. For more information, see [Pricing](~~250950~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse update-gateway-spec --gateway-unique-id gw-c70622ff52fe49beb29bea9a6f520000 --spec MSE_GTW_4_8_200_c --replica 3 --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse UpdateGatewaySpec --region cn-hangzhou --GatewayUniqueId 'gw-c70622ff52fe49beb29bea9a6f520000' --AcceptLanguage zh --Spec MSE_GTW_4_8_200_c --Replica 3
